title: Add descendant changed and descendant moved steps
body: HTML needs to know when the label of an option element changes, which depends on the data of its descendant Text nodes and the alt attributes of its descendant img elements. Mutation observers cannot be used for that from a specification. This adds descendant changed steps, which run for each inclusive ancestor of a node whose children or data change, and descendant moved steps, which run for each inclusive ancestor of the old and new parent of a moved node, along with a warning on how implementations are expected to scope them. Like with the moving steps, specifications opt into handling moves.
